buckets.A: Never found it: the passage holding the gold value, or part of it, never reached the model
buckets.B: Misread it: everything needed reached the model, and the value is still wrong or incomplete
buckets.C: Should have refused: must-refuse question scored as answered
buckets.D: Test is wrong: the answer is right; the scorer's wording match missed it, or the gold value is wrong
buckets.E: Documents disagree: passages from more than one document gave conflicting values and the wrong one was used

verdicts.wrong_value: states a wrong number, rule or reference a reader could act on
verdicts.incomplete: right as far as it goes, but leaves out list items or a branch
verdicts.wrong_refusal_behaviour: answered a must-refuse question, or declined an answerable one
verdicts.not_an_error: the reply is right; the item was scored wrong
